.thermal-receipt{width:74mm;max-width:74mm;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:11px;color:#000;margin:0;padding:0}.receipt-header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:6px}.brand-logo-slot:empty{display:none}.receipt-logo{max-height:38px;max-width:55mm;margin-bottom:4px}.shop-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;margin-top:2px}.shop-info{font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.35;margin-top:2px}.receipt-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px;text-transform:uppercase}.receipt-info{font-size:10px;line-height:1.45}.receipt-info div,.summary-row,.payment-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.receipt-info span{font-weight:600}.receipt-info strong{text-align:right}.receipt-items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px}.receipt-items th{text-align:left;border-bottom:1px dashed #000;padding:3px 0}.receipt-items td{padding:4px td:first-child{width:44%;word-break:break-word}.item-name{font-weight:700}.item-code{font-size:8.5px;color:#555;margin-top:1px}.receipt-summary,.payment-breakdown{font-size:10.5px}.summary-row,.payment-row{padding:2px 0}.grand-total{font-size:14px;font-weight:900;padding:4px 0}.section-title{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px;text-transform:uppercase}.tax-line{font-size:9px;line-height:1.35;padding:2px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted #aaa}.fbr-block{text-align:center}.fbr-logo{display:block;max-width:48mm;max-height:18mm;margin:3px auto}.fbr-qr{display:block;width:25.4mm;height:25.4mm;margin:5px auto}.fbr-note{font-size:9px;line-height:1.3;margin-top:3px}.offline-banner,.reconciliation-banner{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;border:2px solid #000;padding:5px;margin:5px 0;text-align:center}.reconciliation-banner{font-size:10px}.receipt-footer{text-align:center;font-size:10px;margin-top:8px}.thanks{font-weight:800}.powered{margin-top:3px;font-size:9px}hr{border:none;border-top:1px
